reviews.text: Wouldn't take my yorkie to anyone else.  Julisa is an excellent groomer. The staff is very courteous and professional.
This is the gold standard for pet grooming. The owners care about the animals, meticulous, clean and professional.
The best grooming my dog has ever had! They make sure the dogs are well taken care of!

I am so happy with how my old man gets treated here!  He’s going to be 17 years old in December and has lost his eyesight and hearing. He is groomed with patience and love at Golden Paws. Thank you for loving and caring for my Hudson.
Been bringing my dog here for 5 years now! They always do a great job! Very nice people!
The best experience. They treat our Cinnamon with love.

My puppy came out so adorable. I loved the results. The staff was amazing. For his first time going it was amazing! He was so happy, they took very good care of him🥰! He came home smelling good, relaxed  &  looking just “dapper”! GoldenPaws is the place to go, especially if you want your dog to have a personable, friendly, comfortable spa experience ❤️🥰! ZenDiezel loves his new look! Thank You GoldenPaws
Best place for my animal for grooming. Great team and great staff. The groomer is the best
I love the owner she's fabulous and can really cut a dogs hair. She's not practiceing.
For years this has been my go to place to take my boy Huey in for a trim. Considerate, courteous, and professional. Highly recommend!

If i had the option to put no stars i would. I have 2 dogs, same kind of dog but one is a baby. Mother and daughter! Two completely different sizes and weight. They tried to overcharge me for grooming my pets. I dont understand how one person can say pricing is based on weight and then change their mind and proceed to say because it’s the same kind of dog the price is the same. That is extremely unprofessional, and sounds like a way to make a extra couple dollars on the side if yu ask me. I didnt appreciate feeling like i was being scammed. I’ve never encountered a place that does this. I recommend everyone go to Petco, or any other place. The pricing is fair at Petco , and the regulations don’t change. Pricing goes by weight.
